items.title: 1.16 Usability aur security ki saude-bazi (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 1.16 (PDF 21), paragraph for paragraph, with an example tip, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Usability ka matlab hai system ko istemal karna kitna aasan hai. Achha (usable) system saada aur wazeh hota hai. Users use jaldi seekh lete hain. Kaam baghair uljhan ke ho jate hain. Achhi usability waqt aur mehnat bachati hai. Is se user ka itminan (satisfaction) barhta hai.

Security ka matlab hai systems aur data ki hifazat. Yeh be-ijazat rasai rokti hai. Security viruses aur hackers se bachati hai. Yeh maloomat ko raaz mein aur mehfooz rakhti hai. Mazboot security khatre aur nuqsan kam karti hai. Har system ko bunyadi security chahiye.
Usability aur security ke darmiyan tradeoff (ek ko barhao to doosra ghatta hai)

Security barhane se system istemal karna mushkil ho sakta hai. Mazboot passwords yaad rakhna mushkil hai. Login ke izafi qadam users ko sust kar dete hain. Saada systems aasan magar kam mehfooz hote hain. Security hatane se khatra barhta hai. Mehfooz aur aasan istemal ke liye dono mein tawazun (balance) zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Misaal ke taur par password manager ya fingerprint se login mazboot security rakhte hue bhi user ke liye kaam aasan bana dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Aik misal dein jahan izafi security system ko use karna mushkil banati hai, aur us mushkil ko kam karne ka aik tareeqa.
blocks.explanation: Misal: bank app jo har dafa password aur one-time code mangti hai, kholne mein zyada waqt leti hai. Fingerprint ya chehre se login, ya bharosemand device yaad rakhna, kam qadmon mein use mehfooz rakhta hai.

items: Usability: seekhne aur istemal mein aasani; security: be-ijazat rasai aur hamlon se hifazat.
Zyada security aksar kam aasani; dono mein tawazun zaroori.
